title: Event reminders with one-tap "Can't make it" (and push for every notification)
summary: pg_cron reminder at the player's lead time (default 2h) with push actions View / Can't make it (confirmed leave); generic send-notification-push edge fn so all notification types deliver push; late_dropout notice to hosts. Cites Spond, TeamSnap.

title: Share links that open anywhere, with rich previews
summary: Native share sends vteam:// today; switch to https WEB_ORIGIN links and add a Vercel function that injects og:* tags plus an @vercel/og event card (title, time, place, spots left) from anon-readable fields.

title: Accessibility check on every PR (axe-core over the shots harness)
summary: Run axe WCAG 2.1 AA on all scripts/shots screens with mocked Supabase in a CI job; baseline today's findings (contrast 469 nodes, missing title, viewport zoom, unlabelled switches/spinner) and fail on new serious/critical ones.

title: No-show flag: hosts mark who didn't come, and only they miss out on points
summary: Revised at review: everyone counts as present; hosts/co-hosts flag no-shows from the roster ⋯ menu (set_no_show RPC + guard trigger) between start and end+2h. award_event_points pays unflagged attendees at end+2h. Flagged player sees a notice. Replaced the per-player check-in design (too much host work).

title: Balanced teams: split by skill level and spread the setters
summary: Random | Balanced toggle next to Randomize. balanceAssignments in hooks/event/derive.ts: pins first, one setter per team, greedy by skill_level score, swap pass. Team avg + setter chips. Client-only, no schema.

title: Database logic tests: pgTAP + migration up/down round-trip in a throwaway Postgres
summary: CI job db-tests: supabase start in the runner, load beta schema dump, round-trip each new migration (up/down/up compared by schema_fingerprint), then pgTAP tests for points, ad-free, capacity/waitlist, reminders, rollup, Schelagg mapping. Never touches live or shared beta state.

title: Points shop (cosmetics, utility, real prizes) and points for non-vteam events
reason: Bryan tabled it at review on 2026-10-31. Don't re-propose unless he raises it. Unfiled prerequisites from the same discussion: points-farming limits (hosts keep earning; min 4 other attendees, created 2h+ ahead / 30min+, daily cap, 5 pts only for real tournaments) and a Points section in the Terms.
summary: Shop-only cosmetics separate from earned borders; no pay-to-win or transfers; real prizes only after farming limits and Terms update.

title: Waitlist spot offers: the next person gets the spot held, and joins only if they accept
summary: Revised at review: host opt-in (off by default); when a spot opens the next waitlisted player gets a timed hold (15/30/60 min, 10 within 2h of start) and joins only by accepting; pass/expiry moves the offer on (expired players go after never-offered ones). event_spot_offers table, accept/decline RPCs, per-minute expire cron, capacity counts holds; replaces host.tsx client promotion. Bryan rejected auto-adding without consent (fees, forgotten waitlists).
review_note: 2026-11-01: Bryan disliked auto-adding people last minute without consent (fee, forgot they were waitlisted); chose host opt-in + timed offer. Awaiting approval of the revision.

title: Player card setup after sign-up: position, level, home city in three skippable steps
summary: /welcome stack screen shown once after first sign-in when position, skill_level and home city are empty; level options get one-line hints (SKILL_LEVEL_HINTS); marker in user_settings.seen_banners; analytics funnel. No schema. Feeds balanced teams (#149) and regional feed.

title: Background job health check: catch a silent pg_cron or push failure within hours
summary: Anon SECURITY DEFINER job_health() RPC (cron last success/failures, Schelagg freshness, ended events with no points, push webhook non-2xx) + scripts/job-health.mjs EXPECTATIONS + job-health.yml every 3h on live and beta; GitHub emails on failure; CI requires an expectation for every cron job.

title: Calendar sync: a private feed of your games that stays up to date in Apple / Google / Outlook
summary: Per-user secret iCal URL (calendar_feeds table + SECURITY DEFINER calendar_feed(token) RPC served by Vercel api/calendar.ts) listing attending/waitlisted/hosted events; moves and cancellations propagate. Settings → Calendar sync, reset/stop. TeamSnap, Spond, Meetup, Luma.
reason: Bryan skipped it for now at review on 2026-11-02, after asking whether sync is one-time (setup is one tap, then automatic), cost (free for players; well within Vercel/Supabase limits) and permissions (none in-app; one confirm in the calendar app). Not rejected on merit: don't re-propose unless he raises it. If revived, add a one-time 'add your games to your calendar' prompt on first join.

title: Weather on outdoor games: forecast chip on sand and grass cards, hourly row on the event
summary: NWS hourly forecast via a cached Vercel Edge proxy (api/forecast.ts), useForecast keyed by rounded coords; chip on EventCard and ForecastRow in DetailsTab for sand/grass events within 7 days; rain ≥40% / heat index ≥95°F warnings. No schema.

title: Native app smoke tests: Maestro flows on an Android emulator, nightly and on native PRs
summary: native-smoke.yml builds the release APK against beta, runs Maestro flows (guest browse, sign-in, RSVP, scorekeeper restore after kill, native date picker, no tab swipe) on an API 34 emulator, logcat crash scan, fixtures swept. Android first, iOS later.

title: New game alerts: hear when your clubs, or hosts you play with, post a game
summary: new_game notification from a 10-min pg_cron send_new_game_alerts(): club members (per-club mute via club_members.game_alerts) and players with 2+ games by the host (opt-in), filtered by surface/level/time chips in user_settings.game_alerts, game_alert_log dedupe, 3/day cap, grouped per host/club, pushed by the existing webhook. Meetup new-event announcements, Playtomic priority alerts.

title: Leave with a heads-up: a sheet that says what leaving costs, and an optional note to the host
summary: Leave event (attending only) opens LeaveSheet listing only what applies from pure leaveConsequences(): full/waitlist position, approval, host told within 24h, marked paid, points lost; within 24h optional reason chips + note sent as a DM to the host. No schema.

title: Edge functions under test: Deno handler tests on every PR, approved deploy on merge, daily deploy drift check
summary: createHandler(deps) seam in each function, deno lint/check/test with fake Supabase + stub fetch in a CI job, deploy-functions.yml behind a production environment approval, scripts/functions-drift.mjs daily (updated_at vs last commit, verify_jwt vs config.toml, missing/extra).

title: Club polls: "Which night next week?" in one tap, and the winning time becomes the event
summary: Club owners post text or date/time polls in Updates (Spond time polls, Heja polls); members vote in one tap; a closed time poll opens Host prefilled with club/date/time and links to the event. New club_polls/options/votes tables, definer RPCs, club_poll notification.

title: Search games: find a game, place, host or club from the Events tab
summary: Search button in the Events header opens /search (public): upcoming vteam + external sessions, hosts with upcoming games, clubs, typo-tolerant via pg_trgm; signed-in past-games scope; desktop type-ahead. One SECURITY INVOKER RPC search_feed, no tables.

title: Web bundle budget: size report on every PR, fail on unplanned growth of the first-load JS
summary: scripts/bundle-size.mjs after build:web: initial vs lazy JS gz, source-map attribution per package/folder, job summary, fail when initial JS grows >15 KB gz and >3% over committed baseline; bundleImports test enforces icon-barrel/pdf-lib/expo-print/Sentry import rules. Entry is 876 KB gz today.

title: Wake the server from the HTML: start the Events feed request before the app bundle loads
summary: Inline head script starts get_feed_span at ~0.1 s (same span as the hook, viewer token or anon); useMonthEvents adopts it. ~1.6 s off cold first opens on a phone; adds feed_first_paint metric.

title: Player profile, history and cheers on lib/query: cached back-navigation, prefetch on tap, a real error state
summary: useUserProfile / useEventHistory / useCheersSummary replace effect fetches in profile/[id], settings/history, hosted, cheers; fixes false 'Profile not found' on errors; prefetch on avatar press.

title: RLS matrix: every table declares who may read and write it, and CI proves it on beta
summary: Typed matrix of anon/stranger/owner access for all 51 tables (19 asserted today); unit test fails on a table without an entry; generated probes in the api e2e shard on beta.

title: "I'm going" on venue sessions: see who from vteam is going, get a reminder and a cancel notice
summary: external_session_going table (anon read, own insert for upcoming non-canceled sessions), get_external_going batch RPC, going row + toggle on ExternalSessionCard, public /session/[id] page, session_reminder via send_event_reminders and session_cancelled via trigger on the Schelagg ingest. Live: 46 upcoming venue sessions vs 0 vteam games. No points.
reason: Bryan at review: 'going' is only self-reported by vteam users (no venue data), so with today's few players the list would almost always be empty; he doesn't like the idea. Don't re-propose a who's-going list for venue sessions.

title: Push notifications on the web: install on iPhone, one-tap enable, reminders that reach a phone
summary: manifest + tiny sw.js, pushNotifications.web.ts with webPushState (needs-install/ask/on/blocked), Settings card with iPhone Add to Home Screen steps, push_tokens.web_keys, Web Push (VAPID) in send-notification-push/send-chat-push with 410 cleanup. Live has 0 push tokens and all usage is web.
note: Bryan asked why install steps were included; kept after explaining iPhone Safari only allows web push for Home Screen web apps.

title: Host form in pieces: pure form logic, a save hook, and one transactional save_event RPC
summary: Split app/(app)/host.tsx (1,114 lines, 16 useState, 15 supabase.from calls) into utils/hostForm.ts (tested), useHostForm/useHostContext/useSaveEvent and 7 section components; SECURITY INVOKER save_event RPC writes events + tags + waitlist promotion in one transaction, removing partial-save outcomes and an unchecked client-side promotion.

title: Lighter first load on the web: animation and gesture libraries out of the entry chunk
summary: Entry is 3.65 MB raw / 912 KB gz; reanimated+gesture-handler+worklets+hammerjs are 930 KB raw / ~181 KB gz, used only by 7 files on web. GestureRoot.web plain View, lazy TeamsBoard and badge picker chunks, CSS LegendRing and stack fade, lazy react-virtuoso; scripts/entry-deps.mjs guard. ~-210 KB gz (-23%).

title: One notification per game for cheers (and one per event for edits), with one push
summary: Live: 53 cheers_received rows for 15 player-game pairs (max 18), each pushed. notifications.group_key/group_count/last_activity_at + partial unique index; notify_on_kudo_received upserts the unread row per event (UPDATE fires no push webhook); same for event_material_change; client groupNotifications collapses legacy rows; NotificationRow with avatars and cheer chips.

title: Time-zone safety net: unit tests in four zones, clock helpers, one event time zone
summary: Suite passes only in Chicago (3-4 failures in UTC/LA/Tokyo/London); leaveDmText writes the host DM in the sender's zone (real bug); Events TODAY frozen at module load. npm run test:tz in CI, __tests__/helpers/clock.ts, useToday hook, EVENT_TIME_ZONE replaces 5 copies, Tokyo guest e2e.

title: Invite players: hosts ask their regulars to a game, and see who answered
summary: Host picks friends and past players from the People tab; invite notification, one reminder, Waiting/Going/Can't statuses. event_invites table and three RPCs. Gap vs Spond invites and reminders.

title: Startup config from the CDN: three small reads stop waiting on a cold database
summary: app_config, ad_banners and sponsored_events served together from an edge-cached /api/startup with a Supabase fallback; these reads are p50 about 1 s today and guests drop from 4 requests to 1.
note: Bryan at review: keep it only if it actually improves latency. Issue carries a keep-or-revert A/B gate (cdn vs direct per page load).

title: Events screen in pieces: the app's largest file becomes six tested parts
summary: Split the 1,358-line Events tab into calendar components, pure section logic, a hiding hook and two layouts over four PRs, with no visual change.

title: Account basics that work: a password reset that lands where it should
summary: Recovery links always reach the form (web, native via https, expired state); Account shows sign-in details. Bryan at review: no username change, usernames are fixed, enforced by a trigger.

title: Profile opens with 16 requests, not 25: stop loading a tab nobody is looking at
summary: Stop mounting Events on /profile at phone width and remove four duplicate reads; 4.4 s to 2.8 s at a 1 s server, 10-connection pool.

title: Startup guard: CI fails when the first screens get slower or send more requests
summary: Run the cold-open flow in CI with paint and request budgets, name new reads and duplicates, fix the script's 1.5 s measuring floor.

title: Game recap card: after a game, share a picture of it, with a link to the host's next one
summary: Ended games get a 'Your game' card (points, cheers, games this year) with Share: a 1080x1920 picture from a new api/og/recap Edge route plus the event link; guests opening it see the host's next game. Replaces the Leave/spots-left footer that ended games still show. Strava stickers, Playtomic results, Apple Sports cards. No schema change. M.

title: Messages that show up on the web: replace 54 silent Alert.alert calls with one toast and inline errors
summary: Alert.alert is a no-op in react-native-web; 54 calls (9 in useEventAttendance: 'it just filled', join errors; feedback form validation) are silent for web users. lib/toast + one ToastHost, notifyInfo on top of it (no window.alert), inline form errors, theme tokens for Toast, and a test banning Alert imports. M, 5 small PRs.

title: Finish the join you started: a guest who taps Join is signed up and back on the game with one tap to confirm
summary: Save a pending join when a guest taps Join, show the game on the sign-up screen (default New here), drop the silent 'Account created!' + login hop, and on return show a 'Grab your spot?' sheet before player setup (which becomes an inline card). Client-only, funnel metrics. S-M.

title: Reports that reach someone: "Report player" sends a real report, and the team sees it within the hour
summary: Both Report player buttons (profile, DM) only show a success toast. Replace with a sheet (reason, details, also silence) writing a private user_reports row via report_user() RPC, emailing the team, and an Admin metrics Reports tab with dismiss/warn/suspend. Needed for App Store guideline 1.2.

title: Shared event links open with the game already on screen: the event comes inside the page
summary: api/event-page.ts already reads the event for preview tags; read the full anon-visible event + cohosts + public guests there and inline them as a JSON seed that useEventData seeds as stale. Phone, guest, /event/<id>: visible 13.3 s -> ~5.5 s with an 8 s server; Join waits for fresh data.

title: Schema first, then code: hold the production deploy until live has the merged migration
summary: 4 of 11 schema PRs deployed 43 min-3 h before their migration reached live (#232: heartbeat 404, app_events 400 on live). Add a 'Live schema ready' check on push to main (schema-drift --ready, polls) and require it via Vercel Deployment Checks.

title: Back to the same place on desktop: the Events feed keeps its scroll after an event page
summary: Health-check fix: desktop web Back from an event lands Events at the top (900 -> 0 px every run) because the desktop ScrollView has no memoryKey; use DocScrollView (forwarded ref) with tab:events, hide the whole phone screen until restored (one-frame header flash), e2e cases in scrollRestore.spec.ts.

title: Stability check in CI: today's tour, flicker and link checks run on every PR
summary: scripts/shots/stability-flow.mjs on the mocked export in the a11y job: tours never skip, no jump/layout shift on refresh or Back, every VIEW link round-trips; shrink-only baseline like axe; nightly --full with 800 ms delay.

title: What to bring: hosts list the net and balls, players say "I'll bring it"
summary: TeamSnap Assignments / Spond event tasks for pickup gear: host lists items by surface, attending players claim them, claims release on leave, reminder line and a host alert when a required item is uncovered. New tables event_bring_items/claims + RPCs.
